contract.onset_reference: trailing 63 settled closes including the current close
contract.warmup: state becomes available at exactly 63 valid settled closes
contract.active_episode: once onset is confirmed, the episode peak remains frozen until explicit resolution
contract.stabilization: three observed sessions without a new low plus a close above the five-close average
contract.recovery: five consecutive closes above the 20-close average, a rising 20-close average, and ten observed sessions without a new low
contract.trend_repair: 20 consecutive closes above the 20-close average, rising 20-close average, a new high within the trailing 20 closes, and at least 21 observed sessions without a new low
contract.missing_session_safety: persistence resets across an unobserved expected session; moving-average comparisons retain their previously documented contiguous-observation guards

adversarial_findings.summary: rolling onset peak previously retained a 64th close for one extra session
trend repair previously required a 21-close high and an undocumented 40 contiguous observations

adversarial_findings.prior_defect: when the first pending >=2% decline was the trough and the second close confirmed while rebounding, the confirmation close was not counted as the first observed session without a new low
adversarial_findings.repair: initialize no_new_low_closes to the exact contiguous distance from the detected trough to confirmation; pending confirmation cannot span a missing expected session
adversarial_findings.discriminator: 97.0 first pending trough, 98.0 confirmation rebound, then 99.0 and 99.2 => confirmation has no_new_low_closes=1 and the fourth close reaches stabilization with count=3
